Details

I am a member of an advisory board for Pfizer and Merck. I receive no honoraria. Travel costs are reimbursed to employer. I am a member of a global educational advisory board for Pfizer and Merck-Sorono.

I received honoraria from the International Centre for Evidence Based Medicine for two online modules. I have received dividends as a minor shareholder in a medical clinic in Pierrefonds, Quebec. I have received compensation from industry for travel expenses only, for sitting on a board of directors for Food Allergy Canada and the Canadian Premature Babies Foundation. I have received or will be receiving a grant or honorarium from Shire Pharmaceuticals for contributing to an investigator initiated research grant. The Queen's CPD department has received payment from commercial organizations in support of programming. I do not receive personal support or gifts. I have received or will be receiving a grant or honorarium from Shire Pharmaceuticals for contributing to an investigator initiated research grant. I am a member of an advisory board for Abbvie and Merck.
